name: DeepWeeds: Weed Species Image Dataset for Deep Learning
description: An open multiclass weed species image dataset created by James Cook University in Queensland, Australia. Designed to accelerate computer vision and autonomous robotics applications in precision agriculture. Consists of 17,509 high-resolution images (256x256 RGB) capturing 8 nationally significant weed species native to northern Australia's rangelands, along with a negative flora class, photographed in situ under variable natural sunlight.
